channel.title: Knee Battle — Every battle is won on your knees.
channel.description: A free, practical guide to praying for the people and fights that matter most. Build a prayer room, follow a plan, and find words for the nights you have none. EN/PT/ES.

item.title: The Fire
item.description: When prayer has gone cold and you do not want to pray at all.

item.title: The Target
item.description: You are fighting your spouse, your boss, your kid — the wrong opponent.

item.title: The Name
item.description: Who God says you are, when shame says otherwise.

item.title: The House
item.description: Marriage, children, parents — the people under your roof.

item.title: The Ledger
item.description: Guilt, regret, and the past you keep re-reading.

item.title: The Eyes
item.description: Purity, screens, and what you feed yourself in private.

item.title: The Weight
item.description: Money, work, debt, a job lost, a body tired.

item.title: The Wound
item.description: What someone did to you, and forgiveness you cannot manufacture.

item.title: The Table
item.description: Division between believers — friendly fire in the church and the family.
